test_get_loc: test the Index.get_loc method to retrieve the position of a label in a string Index
test_get_loc_raises: test that Index.get_loc raises KeyError when a label is not found in a string Index
test_get_indexer_strings: test Index.get_indexer with pad and backfill methods on a string Index
test_get_indexer_missing: test Index.get_indexer with missing values (None, np.nan, pd.NA) in a string Index
test_get_indexer_non_unique_nas: test Index.get_indexer_non_unique with non-unique NA values in a string Index
test_slice_locs_negative_step: test Index.slice_locs with negative step slices on a string Index
test_slice_locs_dup: test Index.slice_locs on a non-unique string Index with duplicate labels
